display.label: Secret Version
display.description: A value for an existing secret. A secret can hold several versions over time; adding one here does not remove the others.

resource.key_description: A label to identify this version within this request. Not a real GCP identifier -- the secret's actual version number is assigned by Secret Manager when it's created.

validation.pattern_error: Start with a letter; use letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores after that.

fields.label: Secret
fields.description: The secret this version belongs to. Pick from secrets that exist in this project, or type a name if the secret is being created in the same change.

fields.label: Secret value
fields.description: Upload a file or paste the secret payload directly. Maximum size 64 KiB.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Disable to make this version unusable without destroying it.
